name: Postcard
summary: Write a postcard, tear a stamp off the sheet, and watch it get postmarked, flipped and tracked home
about: A two-sided postcard on a desk with an airmail edge. Pick where you are writing from to change the picture side, write your note, add a name and city, then tear a stamp off the perforated sheet. Post it brings down a rubber stamper that inks a dated postmark and wavy lines, flips the card to its picture, sends it off and follows it from Posted to Delivered.
how: Choose Skardu, Karachi or Lahore for the picture side; See front flips the card any time.
Write your message, then add who it is for and pick their city.
Tap a stamp to tear it off the sheet and stick it on; tap another to swap.
Press Post it: a missing stamp or name is pointed out, otherwise it is stamped and sent.
The strip below tracks it to Delivered and a fresh card slides in.
